notes: Windmere Heights (region_windmere). templates\saltmarrow_template8.flp: strings_pizz on guitar_nylon (Ample Guitar M Lite, insert 6), flute on flute_wood (Meadow Flute, insert 2), drum_snare on drum_frame (MA Harpers Tom, key 38 +22 = 60, insert 1), pad_strings on pad_strings (12 Low Strings +12, insert 5), the harp line on reed_concertina (Accordion, insert 4). v2 (review v1): the pad's gain came from the stock-preset stem; with Osc2 off and Osc1 at 7.32 it plays ~15 dB louder, so its gain drops 15.5 dB. Accordion -3 dB, frame drum -4 dB at 125 Hz and +3 dB at 2.5 kHz, guitar low cut 70 Hz, flute high cut 3.5 kHz at 12 dB/oct. Built from projects\region_windmere_v1c.flp (the pad fix lives in that project).
